test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All slippers are knives.

Some knives are rats.

Some rats are pizzas.

Conclusions:

(I) Some pizzas are slippers.

(II) Some rats are slippers.
solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ae2cbb5660bb4050c80d31d2c0a6dd6846b845d4aa4d3c500fb17b4d43c05c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pizzas are slippers. (False, there is no direct relation between pizzas and slippers).

II. Some rats are slippers. (False, there is no direct relation between rats and slippers).

Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence,** the correct answer is option C . **
